name: m5stack-models.js
description: Evidence-based interactive M5Stack controller and Unit models built with Three.js and sticks3.js

scripts.dev: npm run catalog && vite demo --config vite.config.js --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5188 --strictPort
scripts.check:demo: node scripts/check-demo-product-details.mjs && node scripts/check-demo-selection.mjs && node scripts/check-demo-lifecycle.mjs && node scripts/check-demo-framebuffers.mjs
scripts.build: npm run catalog && vite build demo --config vite.config.js --outDir ../dist --emptyOutDir --base ./
